q.en: Dragging a chair across a dirt yard:

o.en: Always forbidden
Allowed unless a furrow is certain
o.he: מותרת אלא אם ודאי ייעשה חריץ

o.en: Allowed only when lifting is impossible
Only rabbinically forbidden

w.en: Davar she-eino mitkaven is permitted; a certain result (psik reisha) isn't.
w.he: דבר שאינו מתכוון מותר; פסיק רישיה – אסור.

q.en: Your sprinkler system was programmed before Shabbat to run on Shabbat:
q.he: מערכת ההשקיה תוכנתה לפני שבת לפעול בשבת:

o.en: Forbidden
Permitted; no Jew does an action on Shabbat
o.he: מותר; יהודי אינו עושה מעשה בשבת

o.en: Only if a non-Jew turns it on
Only in winter

w.en: You may even close it on Shabbat.

q.en: Your child's ball is stuck in a tree branch. What's the halakha?
q.he: הכדור של הילד נתקע בענף. מה הדין?

o.en: Shake the tree gently
Climb up carefully
Leave it until after Shabbat
Knock it down with a stick

w.en: The Sages forbade using a tree in any way.

q.en: Which swing may you use on Shabbat?

o.en: One tied directly to a branch
One hung from a peg driven into the tree
One tied on one side to the tree
None

w.en: Two steps removed from the tree (tzedadei tzedadin) wasn't included in the decree.

q.en: Someone gives you a bouquet with closed buds on Shabbat. What do you do?
q.he: קיבלתם בשבת זר עם ניצנים סגורים. מה עושים?

o.en: Put it in a vase of water
Put it in an empty vase
It's muktzeh
Cut the stems first

w.en: Water would make buds open, which is Zore'a.

q.en: Smelling an etrog or apple still on the tree:
q.he: הרחה באתרוג או תפוח המחוברים לעץ:

o.en: Allowed
Forbidden, lest you pick it to eat
Only for the beracha
Only with permission of the owner

w.en: Fragrant flowers growing in the ground may be smelled.

q.en: Apples fell from your tree and scattered across the yard:

o.en: Gather them all into a basket
Pick up a few to eat
Nothing, they're muktzeh
Sweep them into a pile

w.en: Gathering scattered fruit outdoors is rabbinically forbidden as a weekday activity. (Fruit that fell on Shabbat may be muktzeh; see ch. 23.)
w.he: איסוף פירות מפוזרים בחוץ אסור מדרבנן כעובדין דחול. (פירות שנשרו בשבת עשויים להיות מוקצה; פרק כג.)
